bible_verses.telugu: దేవుడు మనకు ఆశ్రయమును దుర్గమునై యున్నాడు ఆపత్కాలములో ఆయన నమ్ముకొనదగిన సహాయకుడు కావున భూమి మార్పునొందినను నడిసముద్రములలో పర్వతములు మునిగినను వాటి జలములు ఘోషించుచు నురుగు కట్టినను ఆ పొంగునకు పర్వతములు కదలినను మనము భయపడము.(సెలా.)
bible_verses.english: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea, though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకాయన లేచి గాలిని గద్దించినిశ్శబ్దమై ఊరకుండు మని సముద్ర ముతో చెప్పగా, గాలి అణగి మిక్కిలి      నిమ్మళ మాయెను.
bible_verses.english: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

bible_verses.telugu: ఎవనిమనస్సు నీమీద ఆనుకొనునో వానిని నీవు పూర్ణశాంతిగలవానిగా కాపాడుదువు. ఏలయనగా అతడు నీయందు విశ్వాసముంచి యున్నాడు.
bible_verses.english: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, when the world around me feels unstable and shaken, help me keep my eyes fixed entirely on You. Speak Your peace over the chaotic waters of my heart today. I choose to trust Your voice above every fear and doubt. Thank You for being my refuge and holding my life securely in Your hands. Through it all, I declare that my soul is at rest in You. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, when the world around me feels unstable and shaken, help me keep my eyes fixed entirely on You. Speak Your peace over the chaotic waters of my heart today. I choose to trust Your voice above every fear and doubt. Thank You for being my refuge and holding my life securely in Your hands. Through it all, I declare that my soul is at rest in You. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life often feels shaken by sudden storms and overwhelming noise, yet the Creator who spoke the universe into being holds full authority over every wave. When we fix our gaze on Jesus rather than our circumstances, terror yields to deep-seated peace. This song invites us to quiet our anxiety and declare trust in His sovereignty. No matter what quakes around us today, we can anchor our souls in His unfailing presence and truly say, 'It is well.'
